content: Hello, I am Alder Credit's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask two short security questions. What is your postcode?
Thank you. What is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 16 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
No, I won't be paying that today.
Could you pay 900.00 for the credit card on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I won't be able to pay it on Thursday either.
Could you pay 300.00 for the credit card on Thursday 22 October 2026? The remaining balance stays overdue.
No, I'm not going to be able to pay 300 on the 22nd either.
To confirm: the credit card, 300.00 on Thursday 22 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
No, I don't confirm that. I already said I won't be paying 300 on the 22nd.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
